title: Complimenting an Opponent After a Showdown
summaryJa: トーナメント中に相手との間で友好的な交流が生まれています。このような相手へのリスペクトを示すやり取りは、ポーカーテーブルでの良好な雰囲気を作り、自然な会話スキルを磨くのに役立ちます。
segments: You: That was a nice hand. Good read on the river.
Opponent: Thanks! I got lucky with the turn card.
You: No, you played it well. I didn't see it coming.
Opponent: I appreciate that. Good luck for the rest of the tournament.
You: You too. Let's make it a good one.
